import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]);
    rbar=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==3 for x in row)); cbar=next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==3 for i in range(h)))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==3: continue
        # The pattern alternates filled and empty lanes, with recursive gaps.
        a=r if r<rbar else r-rbar-1; b=c if c<cbar else c-cbar-1
        v=1
        while a or b:
          if a%2==1 and b%2==1: v=0
          a//=2; b//=2
        if v: out[r][c]=4
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
g=[[0]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for i in range(12):g[i][6]=3
g[8]=[3]*12
ans=transform(g)
print(ans)
